location_exception_reason: Dairy farm infrastructure is regionally adapted to agro-climatic zones (tropical, subtropical, temperate); buyers explicitly search for zone-specific shed designs and material recommendations. Location signals genuine product differentiation, not just seller geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Dairy Farm Contractor', 'Shed Manufacturer', 'Consultancy Service') describe seller role, not product attributes. IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Contractor, Consultant) already exposes this distinction; removing the word leaves the product complete and unambiguous.
